package.name: sbgc_driver
package.description:
ROS 2 driver for SimpleBGC32 (BaseCam / AlexMos) camera gimbal controllers.
Publishes joint state, IMU, battery and diagnostics; accepts rate commands as control_msgs/JointJog and angle targets as control_msgs/FollowJointTrajectory. Every decision about what reaches the serial port lives in GimbalCore, which has no ROS dependency and is tested on its own.
